start: Settings, gym online, timings saved before

steps.action: Open Settings, then Gym timings
user_sees: Title 'Gym timings'
'When your gym is open, for members to see'
'Right now members see: <open or closed line>'
Card 'Every week' with a box for each of the seven days
'Last saved <day> by <name>.'
must_not: 'Loading…' that never ends
Another branch's timings shown as this gym's

steps.action: Change Monday's closing time, then tap 'Copy Monday to Tue to Sat'
user_sees: Tuesday to Saturday show the same times as Monday
The button reads 'Save timings' and can be tapped
must_not: Sunday changed by the copy
The change sent to members before Save is tapped

steps.action: Tap 'Save timings'
user_sees: Button reads 'Saving…'
Toast 'Gym timings saved. Members see them in the MettleUp app (Gym tab) within 10 minutes.'
Button reads 'Saved ✓'
'These timings are saved (<day>) and members see them. Change any time above to save again.'
must_not: The saved toast when the save failed
Two saves from two fast taps

start: Gym online, no timings saved yet (first time: start from a ready-made week, add a special day and a note)

steps.action: Open Gym timings
user_sees: Card 'Start from'
'Pick the one closest to your gym, then change any day.'
A row for each ready-made week
must_not: An empty editor with no days
A Save button before a week is picked

steps.action: Tap one ready-made week
user_sees: Card 'Every week' filled in
Button 'Save and show members'
must_not: Members told the gym is open before anything is saved
A line that says members see these times 'right now' while nothing is saved

steps.action: Tap '+ Add a special day', pick a date, type 'Diwali' in 'why (optional)', choose 'Closed'; type one line in 'Note for members (optional)'
user_sees: Card 'Special days' with 'Add holidays like Diwali, or days with other times. Members see them on the Gym tab 7 days before.'
A row 'Special day 1: date' and 'Special day 1: why (optional)'
Hint 'Type up to 120 letters here to tell members something they should know about your gym timings.'
must_not: More than 30 special days can be added
A special day with no date saved without a word

steps.action: Tap 'Save and show members'
user_sees: Toast 'Gym timings saved. Members see them in the MettleUp app (Gym tab) within 10 minutes.'
On Get started, 'Set your gym timings' is ticked
must_not: The special day or the note missing after the page is opened again

start: Gym timings open in the editor

steps.action: Set a day to 'Times' and clear its opening time
user_sees: 'Fix the times below to see what members will see.'
must_not: A made-up open or closed line for a week that is not complete

steps.action: Tap 'Save timings'
user_sees: A red banner above the editor that names the problem (exact words are in the timings rules, not read in this step)
The editor stays as typed
must_not: Broken timings saved
The saved toast

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at the Save and Remove buttons
user_sees: Both buttons greyed, with the needs-internet words
must_not: A save that looks done while offline

steps.action: Sign in on a gym that is not online and open Gym timings
user_sees: 'Gym timings need your gym online'
'Members’ phones read the timings from your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An editor that saves only on this device

start: Gym timings saved and shown in the editor

steps.action: Tap 'Remove timings'
user_sees: Sheet 'Remove the gym timings?'
'Members will no longer see when your gym is open. You can add the timings again at any time.'
Buttons 'Keep them' and 'Remove'
must_not: Timings removed before Remove is tapped

steps.action: Tap 'Keep them'
user_sees: The sheet closes; the editor is unchanged
must_not: Any change sent to the server

steps.action: Tap 'Remove timings', then 'Remove'
user_sees: Toast 'Gym timings removed. Members no longer see them.'
Card 'Start from' is back
must_not: The old timings still shown to members after 10 minutes
The 'Last saved' line still on the page

steps.action: Pick a ready-made week and tap 'Save and show members'
user_sees: The saved toast; the editor shows the new week
must_not: The removed special days or note coming back by themselves

start: Gym timings editor, gym with a note and two branches

steps.action: Read the lines under the top card
user_sees: 'Members see these on the Gym tab of the MettleUp app: “Open now · closes 10:00 pm”, and the whole week. Times are India time.'
must_not: The 'Last saved … by <name>' staff name shown to members
A note shown to members before Save

steps.action: Switch to the other branch and open Gym timings
user_sees: 'When <branch name> is open. Each branch has its own timings.'
That branch's own week
must_not: One branch's timings saved over the other branch's
Members of one branch shown the other branch's hours

start: Front desk signed in, gym online, timings saved by the owner

steps.action: Open Settings, then Gym timings
user_sees: Card 'Your gym’s timings'
'Right now members see: <open or closed line>'
The week, any coming special days and the note
'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'
must_not: Any time box, Save button or Remove button
Special days that are already over

steps.action: Open Gym timings when the owner has saved none
user_sees: 'No timings yet.'
'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'
must_not: The 'Start from' list offered to the front desk

steps.action: Open Gym timings when the server does not have timings yet
user_sees: 'Gym timings are not switched on for your gym yet'
'They will appear here once your gym’s server has them.'
must_not: A raw error text

steps.action: Open Gym timings with the internet off
user_sees: A red banner with the reason and a button
'Try again'
must_not: 'Loading…' for ever
Old timings shown as if they were fresh

start: Front desk has Gym timings open; the owner then changes the timings on another device

steps.action: Leave the page and open Gym timings again
user_sees: The owner's new week and the new 'Right now members see' line
must_not: The old week after the page is opened again
A different answer from what the member app shows

steps.action: The owner removes the timings; open the page again
user_sees: 'No timings yet.'
must_not: The removed week still listed

start: Front desk signed in, timings saved

steps.action: Read the whole card
user_sees: The same week, special days and note that members see
'Only the owner can change the gym timings.'
must_not: Any way for the front desk to change the timings
The server accepting a save from a front-desk sign-in
